analysis:
The changes in this PR to docs/provider/cli-reference.md are documentation-only. I examined both units, which cover head lines 805-1724. The changed ranges are head 961-963, where a new paragraph describes a 15 s per-model unload wait at shutdown, and head 1041-1056, where new status text describes a restart-needed notice and 'Retrying' lines. No code, configuration or control is altered, so no security control regresses.

Threat-model relevance:
- The shutdown note at 961-963 says a model whose native retirement never finishes is left to process exit. This touches T-028 (residual GPU data) and T-029 (availability). It documents bounded shutdown behavior, not a new weakness. Whether the underlying code in ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown actually wipes residual KV or GPU state on process exit is not in the supplied evidence, so I flag nothing.
- The status text describes self-reported daemon-state fields (enabled_models_at_start, enabled_models_at_last_switch) shown only locally. It adds no exposure of prompts or keys. The text states that model names and exact load figures stay private in the logs and appear only in the owner's live status and doctor output. That is consistent with the data-minimisation posture.
- The prefix cache text (T-041) mentions only the cache status vocabulary and the FAILED message. It does not weaken the TTL, HMAC naming or scope claims.
- The autopilot, logout and unenroll sections are unchanged context. Their statements are consistent with the TB-011 and A-008 rescope notes, since logout does not claim remote revocation without HTTP 204.

Remaining questions for integration: the Swift implementation referenced by the docs (ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown, StatusCommand+Residency) is not in this batch. This pass cannot confirm that the documentation matches the code.
